To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1. Lung Clearance Index (LCI) and HRCT are both sensitive markers of lung abnormalities, but LFTs do not correlate well with each other; 2. HRCT is a more sensitive marker of lung disease than any other lung function measure in young children with cystic fibrosis; 3. LCI and HR CT are complimentary markers of lung abnormalities; 4. LFTs are not sensitive enough to be useful as a screening test for early CF lung disease.
